text: Gave talks at the MIT HCI Seminar and the UofT Dynamic Graphics Project.
Attended UIST 2026 in Detroit. Spoke as a keynote panelist at the In2Writing workshop. Coauthors presented work on our systems Elsewise, Trinketry, and UISTful.
Gave a talk at the Columbia HCI Seminar.
Serving as a Keynote Chair for the new human-AI interaction conference HAIC.
Joined Cornell Tech and launched the Creativity Support Lab! Welcome aboard to new PhD students Vann and Eric.
